summary: Macerich Co filed a 424B5 preliminary prospectus supplement for an offering of 14 million common shares via forward sale agreements with Goldman Sachs and other institutions. The shares trade on the NYSE under MAC; last price $25.45 on June 12, 2026. Proceeds will be received only upon physical settlement within ~12 months. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation—it is a routine capital raise under an existing shelf registration. No change of control, board recommendation, or strategic review is disclosed. This is an ordinary equity offering for a REIT.
